message.content: Li Hua requested extra exercises to do at home to complement his training schedule, aiming to enhance his overall fitness and maximize his progress. This request came from Jennifer Moore, who suggested several at-home exercises such as bodyweight squats, plank holds, push-ups, lunges, and glute bridges. Li Hua expressed enthusiasm for the additional workouts and asked for guidance on when to incorporate them into his routine, specifically whether they should be done on off days or mixed in with his training days.
